name: Forge
text: I propose that we prioritize creating a consistent package design template that all creators can use. By establishing a unified style, we can enhance our brand identity and streamline the creation process, making it easier for everyone to contribute effectively. The trade-off here is that by enforcing a template, we may limit individual creativity in design. However, the benefits of maintaining quality and coherence across our work outweigh this drawback.

name: Vet
text: I'm not convinced that a uniform package design template is the best use of our resources, as it may stifle creativity and limit the ability of individual creators to innovate and experiment with new ideas. A better approach might be to establish a set of guidelines andbest practices that allow for flexibility and autonomy, while still maintaining a cohesive brand identity. To settle this argument, I'd like to see some data on how a uniform template would impact our creation process and overall brand recognition, as well as some examples of successful companies that have taken a similar approach.
